steps.name: Glaucus
steps.text: How much longer?

steps.name: Blue Poison
steps.text: Be patient.

steps.name: Glaucus
steps.text: It smells really good, though.

steps.name: Blue Poison
steps.text: This is the most enjoyable moment in baking. Watching the batter slowly turn golden and puff up in the oven, until it turns into a soft, fluffy cake...

steps.name: Blue Poison
steps.text: Desserts taste best when you let your imagination run wild, Glau.

steps.name: Glaucus
steps.text: I'd rather have one I can put in my mouth. So what's our flavor of the day?

steps.name: Blue Poison
steps.text: Hm... It's a new formula. Fresh cream mixed with a jam made from various kinds of berries. That gives it a sort of tropical flavor.

steps.name: Glaucus
steps.text: Sure, but its color is as terrifying as ever. Your fashion sense is pretty decent, so how the heck did your sense for food aesthetics end up downright rotten?

steps.name: Blue Poison
steps.text: Hm? But I heard brighter colors can help increase appetites.

steps.name: Glaucus
steps.text: I think most people would disagree with your definition of bright colors.

steps.name: Blue Poison
steps.text: You say that, but you'll still eat it in the end.

steps.name: Glaucus
steps.text: That's 'cause it tastes good.

steps.name: Glaucus
steps.text: Too bad all those self-proclaimed dessert lovers will never know the kind of lusciousness they're missing out on.

steps.name: Blue Poison
steps.text: Not everyone's special like you.

steps.name: Glaucus
steps.text: It's not like you poison your cakes.

steps.name: Glaucus
steps.text: *Sigh*... Normally, this break room would be pretty packed around now, but it feels like there have been way less people ever since we arrived.

steps.name: Blue Poison
steps.text: Don't say that. I'm not being ostracized or anything. I'm actually very happy with my life here.

steps.name: Blue Poison
steps.text: But the best way to get along with something 'toxic' is to stay away from it. I know that, you know that, everyone knows that.

steps.name: Blue Poison
steps.text: On the bright side, how often do you get the whole break room to yourself? Let's try to enjoy this before we head out for our field mission.

steps.name: Glaucus
steps.text: I suppose we won't get much of a chance to enjoy a cake in the Sargon Barrenlands anyway.

steps.name: Blue Poison
steps.text: I hope the mission goes well.

steps.name: Glaucus
steps.text: You say that like you have nothing to do with it. Aren't you the leader of the guerrilla team? True, all we're doing is building a safe house, but we can't let our guard down.

steps.name: Glaucus
steps.text: I heard it's way off the beaten track. Who knows what we'll run into out there. What was it called again...?

steps.name: Blue Poison
steps.text: Kerthun.

steps.name: Glaucus
steps.text: Right, Kerthun Valley. Have you ever been there?

steps.name: Blue Poison
steps.text: No, never.

steps.name: Glaucus
steps.text: Hm, then I guess I'll read over the mission briefing while we eat. First I need to confirm the supply point...

steps.name: Glaucus
steps.text: Oh, sounds like it's done.

steps.name: Blue Poison
steps.text: Alright, now to put the cream on it...
Adnachiel, are you baking another cake behind my back again?!

steps.name: Glaucus
steps.text: Oh.

steps.name: Blue Poison
steps.text: Ambriel?

steps.name: Ambriel
steps.text: Sorry, I smelled cake, so I just...

steps.name: Glaucus
steps.text: You want some too? It's straight out of the oven.

steps.name: Ambriel
steps.text: No, I think I'll...

steps.name: Ambriel
steps.text: (Gulps)

steps.name: Ambriel
steps.text: Did Blue Poison make this...? Why can't it ever be easy?

steps.name: Blue Poison
steps.text: Please, go ahead and try some if you don't mind. We have tea, too.

steps.name: Ambriel
steps.text: Hmm, well, not like I have anything better to do... Guess I can kill some time here.

steps.name: Ambriel
steps.text: As for the cake, let me prepare myself mentally first.

steps.name: Blue Poison
steps.text: Um, if you're worried about poison, you don't need to force yourself...

steps.name: Ambriel
steps.text: Nah, that's not it.

steps.name: Ambriel
steps.text: Isn't, like, the color of that jam kinda creepy?

steps.name: Ambriel
steps.text: Phew—

steps.name: Glaucus
steps.text: Tasty, right?

steps.name: Ambriel
steps.text: I've heard about your baking from Gummy, but this is something else. You could drive half of Laterano's dessert shops out of business.

steps.name: Ambriel
steps.text: The two-bit ones always just load up on sugar, with no idea how to balance flavors. Sweet doesn't have to mean unbearably sweet!

steps.name: Blue Poison
steps.text: ...Wow. It's an honor to hear that from a bona fide Lateran.

steps.name: Ambriel
steps.text: You should feel even prouder then, 'cause praise from an expert like me is worth its weight in gold.

steps.name: Glaucus
steps.text: If only more people were willing to give them a shot. I always feel guilty getting the whole cake to myself.

steps.name: Ambriel
steps.text: Well, I, for one, am willing to put my life on the line for an exquisite dessert.

steps.name: Blue Poison
steps.text: ...So you were worried, after all?

steps.name: Blue Poison
steps.text: If so, Medical has an antidote specifically for my toxins. It's kind of embarrassing to say this myself, but if you need it—

steps.name: Ambriel
steps.text: Shoot, sorry, I didn't mean it like that!

steps.name: Glaucus
steps.text: Watch out, your bag!

steps.name: Glaucus
steps.text: These are...

steps.name: Ambriel
steps.text: Ahaha, I had the antidote prepared in advance. I mean, we *are* going on a field op together in a couple days.

steps.name: Glaucus
steps.text: Oh, right, you're part of our team this mission.

steps.name: Ambriel
steps.text: Yeah, so we're gonna be fighting side by side, right? It's just a precaution, a precaution. Y'know what they say, better safe than...

steps.name: Ambriel
steps.text: I'm sorry, I'm sorry, I'm so sorry!

steps.name: Blue Poison
steps.text: No, please don't apologize. I actually prepared enough antidote for everyone too. It's my responsibility for being toxic.

steps.name: Blue Poison
steps.text: If everyone else is uncomfortable with me being there, then I should be the one apologizing.

steps.name: Ambriel
steps.text: Blue Poison...

steps.name: Ambriel
steps.text: Then, like, can I have another slice?

steps.name: Blue Poison
steps.text: Ambriel?

steps.name: Blue Poison
steps.text: Please, I know you're trying to be kind, but you don't have to—

steps.name: Ambriel
steps.text: C'mon, what of self-respecting Lateran would force themselves to eat cake? Just gimme another slice.

steps.name: Glaucus
steps.text: Huh. I think I'm starting to see you in a new light. Here you go.

steps.name: Ambriel
steps.text: Thanks.

steps.name: Ambriel
steps.text: But man, I wish I could just have complete trust in my friends like you, Glaucus.

steps.name: Glaucus
steps.text: Oh, that's because her toxins don't work on me.

steps.name: Ambriel
steps.text: *Cough* *cough*!

steps.name: Glaucus
steps.text: Slow down! Here, have some antidote.

steps.name: Ambriel
steps.text: *Cough*! No, no that, tea, tea—

steps.name: Glaucus
steps.text: You sure? This is fruit juice-flavored. I had Dr. Warfarin come up with the formula.

steps.name: Ambriel
steps.text: Who cares, just give it!

steps.name: Blue Poison
steps.text: Pfff... Hahahaha!

steps.name: Blue Poison
steps.text: Thanks, Ambriel.

steps.name: Blue Poison
steps.text: If only... all my days here at Rhodes Island could be like this.

steps.name: Ambriel
steps.text: Pwah—That hits the spot! Sorry, what was that?

steps.name: Blue Poison
steps.text: Oh, nothing.

steps.name: Blue Poison
steps.text: Anyway, since you're here, let's read over the mission briefing while we're eating.

steps.name: Ambriel
steps.text: Huh? We're really gonna start working, just like that? This is the break room! I came here to slack off!

steps.name: Ambriel
steps.text: But fine, fine, I'll work overtime, just for you, Bloop. Like, I have to thank you for the cake.
The Kerthun Valley is situated in a vast rainforest within Sargon's borders. Since time immemorial, it has never been under the direct control of the Sargonian lords ameer.
This was the most important factor in Rhodes Island's decision to build a safe house there.
There are many reasons for its unique geopolitical position. Data show that the area is abundant with natural resources, and many lords ameer have tried to expand their influence into the region.
Yet their efforts were all in vain.

steps.name: Glaucus
steps.text: The specific reasons require further investigation, but according to a local guide, it very likely has to do with the indigenous people.

steps.name: Glaucus
steps.text: Those natives are also the biggest variable in our mission. The guide said they aren't too hard to get along with, but also warned that they possess a terrifying ability.

steps.name: Glaucus
steps.text: We only have vague descriptions of the phenomenon in question, but based on our analysis, their ability might be an application of some kind of toxic chemical compound...

steps.name: Ambriel
steps.text: Whoa, sounds like a huge pain.

steps.name: Glaucus
steps.text: Relax. The mission's difficulty rating isn't all that high. We aren't there to pick a fight.

steps.name: Glaucus
steps.text: Blue Poison?

steps.name: Blue Poison
steps.text: Oh, don't mind me. Go on.

steps.name: Glaucus
steps.text: Okay, where was I...

steps.name: Glaucus
steps.text: We're going to build a safe house there. It will also be used as both a Catastrophe monitoring station and a temporary medical post. Our job will be over once the local employees have moved in.

steps.name: Ambriel
steps.text: Yep, about as standard as it gets.

steps.name: Glaucus
steps.text: In other words, if all goes well, we'll be back on the landship baking cakes in a couple of months.

steps.name: Ambriel
steps.text: What do you mean, 'if all goes well'? You trying to jinx us?!

steps.name: Glaucus
steps.text: ...Have you considered that you're a little oversensitive?

steps.name: Ambriel
steps.text: Still, there's one thing that's kinda bothering me. Those natives... Like, what race are they?

steps.name: Glaucus
steps.text: We have no data on it. Supposedly, they don't have any particular distinctive features, but...

steps.name: Blue Poison
steps.text: They're Anura.

steps.name: Blue Poison
steps.text: Just like me.

steps.name: Glaucus
steps.text: ...How do you know?

steps.name: Blue Poison
steps.text: Because they're from my tribe.

steps.name: Blue Poison
steps.text: Kerthun is my homeland.

steps.name: Glaucus
steps.text: What? Why are you only telling us this now? This is news to me!

steps.name: Blue Poison
steps.text: I had no reason to bring it up, Glau. I wasn't lying when I said I'd never been there. I grew up in Iberia.

steps.name: Blue Poison
steps.text: Everything I know about the place, I learned from my grandmother.

a.text: Kerthun. That the name of our homeland.
Only there are we not treated as outsiders.
Only there can we truly live a peaceful life.
Only there are we not burdened with being a 'poison.'

steps.name: Ambriel
steps.text: So what's it like?

steps.name: Blue Poison
steps.text: Hm, I'm not too sure myself. My grandma told me a lot of stories, but honestly she made it all sound a bit too wonderful, like a fairy tale.

steps.name: Blue Poison
steps.text: My people moved from Sargon to Iberia over a hundred years ago. 'Moved,' she told me. Even that is something of a euphemism for the bitter truth.

steps.name: Blue Poison
steps.text: We were sold to Iberia as test subjects. Our lives are inseparable from poison from the moment we're born. It's an unfortunate talent, but some people always see things differently.

steps.name: Blue Poison
steps.text: Conspiracies and poison. Two sides of the same coin, don't you think?

steps.name: Ambriel
steps.text: Listen, we don't have to talk about this if you don't want to.

steps.name: Blue Poison
steps.text: I'm fine. But thanks for worrying about me.

steps.name: Blue Poison
steps.text: Truth is, I've only heard about these experiments secondhand. Ever since the disaster, Iberia's been too busy sorting out its own mess to deal with outcasts like us.

steps.name: Blue Poison
steps.text: That cruel past is now nothing more than stories passed down by the older generation, and Kerthun itself is even more of a legend to us.

steps.name: Blue Poison
steps.text: My grandma always started off like, 'A long time ago, when we were still in faraway Kerthun...' You've all heard stories like that too, right?

steps.name: Glaucus
steps.text: 'A long time ago, when the Ægir still lived under the sea...'

steps.name: Ambriel
steps.text: 'A long time ago, before Laterano was completed...'

steps.name: Blue Poison
steps.text: Hehe, see? All legends start the same.

steps.name: Ambriel
steps.text: Yeah... I don't think I could laugh that off.

steps.name: Blue Poison
steps.text: It was those legends of beautiful Kerthun that kept my family going, from one generation to the next.

steps.name: Blue Poison
steps.text: It was a paradise. A place where no one would fear or scorn us as 'toxic.'

steps.name: Blue Poison
steps.text: My grandma always said our life of ostracization and fear was just a trial for us to endure. Once we were back in Kerthun, everything would be better.

steps.name: Blue Poison
steps.text: This might sound funny, but it was only on her deathbed that she finally told me that she'd never even been there either. And she was the oldest in our family.

steps.name: Blue Poison
steps.text: All those stories she'd loved telling us were made up, based on the stories *she'd* heard growing up, and her own imagination.

steps.name: Blue Poison
steps.text: She didn't even know where it was.

steps.name: Glaucus
steps.text: But now we do.

steps.name: Blue Poison
steps.text: Yeah. And I never imagined I'd find out like this.

steps.name: Ambriel
steps.text: Great! Like, now you get a chance to go back home! Does it really count as home, though...?

steps.name: Glaucus
steps.text: Speaking from experience, you should keep your expectations in check. The actual Kerthun might be nothing like the legends.

steps.name: Glaucus
steps.text: (Uneasy) And you'd still rather stay at Rhodes Island, right?

a.text: Only there are we not burdened with being a 'poison.'

steps.name: Glaucus
steps.text: Blue Poison?

steps.name: Blue Poison
steps.text: Yeah, perhaps.

steps.name: Blue Poison
steps.text: But if that's the only place where I can be myself...

steps.name: Blue Poison
steps.text: Doctor?

options: I'm here for a snack break.

steps.name: Ambriel
steps.text: Phew, don't scare me like that. I'm not slacking off, okay?!

steps.name: Glaucus
steps.text: Doctor, want to try some cake that Blue Poison baked? It's fresh out of the oven.

steps.name: Blue Poison
steps.text: B-But...

steps.name: Blue Poison
steps.text: U-Um, if you don't mind, I have some antidotes prepared...

steps.name: Blue Poison
steps.text: No, wait, your situation is a little unique. Let me get Dr. Kal'tsit first—

options: The berries, plantains, and nuts make it so good.

steps.name: Blue Poison
steps.text: Um... Are you really okay?

steps.name: Glaucus
steps.text: You've had two people trying out your cake today. That's a new record.

steps.name: Blue Poison
steps.text: Yep, a new record.

steps.name: Glaucus
steps.text: Don't overthink it, Blue. You've always belonged here.

steps.name: Blue Poison
steps.text: Thanks, Ambriel, Glaucus.

steps.name: Blue Poison
steps.text: And thank you, Doctor.

steps.name: Blue Poison
steps.text: If... If I can really...

steps.name: Blue Poison
steps.text: No, never mind. Please forget I said anything.

steps.name: Blue Poison
steps.text: See you at the meeting, Doctor.

options: Have you all read up on the mission?

steps.name: Blue Poison
steps.text: Yes, we're quite familiar with the details.

steps.name: Blue Poison
steps.text: But I would like to repeat my request to be removed as team captain. I'm not the right person to lead a team in an operation.

steps.name: Blue Poison
steps.text: Everybody knows that my toxins could harm others...

steps.name: Blue Poison
steps.text: Really...?

steps.name: Glaucus
steps.text: That's right. We're counting on you, Captain.

steps.name: Ambriel
steps.text: 'Sides, we've got, like, tons of antidotes.

steps.name: Glaucus
steps.text: Apple-flavored, too.

steps.name: Blue Poison
steps.text: Haha... I guess.

options: Can I leave this to you, Captain Blue Poison?

steps.name: Blue Poison
steps.text: I will give it my all.

steps.name: Glaucus
steps.text: Okay, off we go now.

steps.name: Blue Poison
steps.text: Yep, see you in a little.

steps.name: Blue Poison
steps.text: Let me help you clean up your files, Doctor.

steps.name: Blue Poison
steps.text: (Did our hands... just touch?!)

steps.name: Blue Poison
steps.text: I'm so sorry I touched you!

steps.name: Blue Poison
steps.text: Please come with me. We need to head to Medical to get it cleaned up! If not... If not...

options: I've checked, minor contact isn't a problem.

steps.name: Blue Poison
steps.text: But...!

steps.name: Blue Poison
steps.text: But I... I'm 'toxic.' Anything that touches me is in danger.

options: You're a member of Rhodes Island.

steps.name: Blue Poison
steps.text: Am I really allowed to be?

steps.name: Blue Poison
steps.text: —Phew.

steps.name: Blue Poison
steps.text: In that case, I'd like to remove an application from that stack of documents.

steps.name: Blue Poison
steps.text: I actually submitted a transfer request not too long ago. I was hoping to be stationed at the Kerthun safe house after the mission.

steps.name: Blue Poison
steps.text: When I was a kid, my grandmother told me that Kerthun was the only place where we could ever live without being branded 'toxic.' And I believed her.

steps.name: Blue Poison
steps.text: But I'm the only one who can decide who I am, aren't I?

steps.name: Blue Poison
steps.text: I'm a member of Rhodes Island, and I like my life here.

steps.name: Blue Poison
steps.text: So please, let me withdraw that application before anyone reads it.

steps.name: Blue Poison
steps.text: Oh, and one other thing, Doctor...

steps.name: Blue Poison
steps.text: I have an idea for a new dessert. Would you like to try it later, if you have time?
